The other sides are each divided into $m$ congruent segments, and the endpoints of one of these segments are joined to the center to form triangle $B$. [See figure for $n = 5, m = 7$.]; What is the ratio of the area of triangle $A$ to the area of triangle $B$?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a rectangle, with the left and right vertical sides equally divided; in the sample, the vertical side corresponds to n=5. The base of triangle A is one equally divided small segment on the left vertical side, and the third vertex is connected to the center of the rectangle. The upper and lower horizontal sides are also equally divided; in the sample, the horizontal side corresponds to m=7. The base of triangle B is one equally divided small segment on the lower horizontal side, and the third vertex is also connected to the center of the rectangle. Reasoning: Let the width of the rectangle be W and the height be H. The vertical side is divided into n congruent small segments, so the base length of triangle A is H/n. The perpendicular distance from the center of the rectangle to the vertical side is W/2, therefore area(A) = (1/2)(H/n)(W/2) = WH/(4n). The horizontal side is divided into m congruent small segments, so the base length of triangle B is W/m. The perpendicular distance from the center of the rectangle to the horizontal side is H/2, therefore area(B) = (1/2)(W/m)(H/2) = WH/(4m). Therefore area(A)/area(B) = [WH/(4n)]/[WH/(4m)] = m/n.

method.method_draft: Use direct base-height computation. From the image, identify triangle A as having its base equal to one divided segment on a vertical side of the rectangle, and triangle B as having its base equal to one divided segment on a horizontal side; both triangles have their third vertex at the rectangle's center. Let the rectangle have width W and height H. The text says the vertical sides are divided into n congruent segments, so A has base H/n, and the horizontal sides are divided into m congruent segments, so B has base W/m. The perpendicular distance from the center to a vertical side is W/2, and the perpendicular distance from the center to a horizontal side is H/2. Thus area(A) = (1/2)(H/n)(W/2) and area(B) = (1/2)(W/m)(H/2). Divide these expressions to get area(A)/area(B) = m/n.

method.method_draft: Use equal-area subdivision of larger side-center triangles. From the image, imagine joining the entire left side of the rectangle to the center; triangle A is one of n smaller triangles cut from that larger triangle because its base is one of the n congruent side segments. That full left-side-to-center triangle has base H and height W/2, so its area is WH/4, making area(A) = WH/(4n). Similarly, joining the entire bottom side to the center gives a larger triangle of area WH/4, and triangle B is one of m equal-area pieces because the bottom side is divided into m congruent segments. Hence area(B) = WH/(4m). Therefore area(A)/area(B) = [WH/(4n)]/[WH/(4m)] = m/n.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个矩形，左、右两条竖边被分成若干相等小段，左边某一个小段的两个端点都连到矩形中心，形成标记为 A 的三角形；上、下两条横边也被分成若干相等小段，底边某一个小段的两个端点都连到矩形中心，形成标记为 B 的三角形。图示对应 n=5、m=7，但问题要求一般情形。

推理：设矩形的宽为 W，高为 H。把整个左边与中心相连，可得到一个大三角形，它的底是整条左边，长度为 H，高是中心到左边的距离，即 W/2，所以面积为 H·(W/2)/2 = WH/4。三角形 A 的底只是左边被分成的 n 个相等小段中的一段，因此 A 是这个大三角形按底边等分得到的 n 个等面积小三角形之一，所以 area(A)=WH/(4n)。同理，把整个底边与中心相连得到的大三角形面积也是 WH/4；底边被分成 m 个相等小段，三角形 B 是其中一段对应的小三角形，所以 area(B)=WH/(4m)。因此 area(A)/area(B) = [WH/(4n)]/[WH/(4m)] = m/n。
